_smokey_adams_: Quentin Adams left twin brothers too young to enlist behind in Coldwater and came up the line with a letter he never sent. The men noticed at once that he will not eat before a raid.
Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Quentin Adams shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Isidor Glc and Quentin Adams tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
Quentin Adams wrote a letter for Edmund Crack's mother, because Edmund could not find the words. Edmund signed it.

A bullet went through Quentin Adams's sleeve at R-F8 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso of the Hegemony (@jozifanderson). The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Quentin Adams read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Quentin Adams no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
A rat stole Quentin Adams's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Quentin Adams put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
Quentin Adams bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage.

Quentin Adams threw a bomb into a Hegemony dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Gideon Hayden was down and screaming for a medic. (@hayden.dt) Quentin Adams came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir. The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into R-F8. Quentin Adams has learned to walk bent double.

Quentin Adams practised asking for bread in the local language. The dugout supplied an audience and several confidently incorrect pronunciations. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Quentin Adams answered to number 118.
alexquinn2802: Clement Alexquinn, a fisherman from Marrow Fen, was sent forward on Day 10 to fill a gap in P-F5. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

Clement Alexquinn was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony. Mail came up the line with a letter for Clement Alexquinn. Clement Alexquinn read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
autistic_monkey3: After 3 days of war, S-F20 had a place for everything. On Day 4, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Florian Monkey.
A shell hit the latrine at S-F20. Nobody was hurt. Florian Monkey says it was the best day of the war.

Wiring party. Florian Monkey held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at S-F20, and everyone came back. Dawn watch. Florian Monkey put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Cyril Miller, grazed. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into S-F20. Florian Monkey has learned to walk bent double.
Florian Monkey and Leopold Ker made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
Florian Monkey fired at a movement across the wire at S-F20. The man went down: Konrad "Crow" Dinhdong, grazed.
Florian Monkey got a letter from Josef. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.
Florian Monkey raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F20. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Walter Juizy of the Hegemony (@juizy_44).

Florian Monkey came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Florian Monkey read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Florian Monkey wrote back to Josef and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Florian Monkey is number 264. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech.
bangnbreach: Wendel "Crow" Bangnbreach introduced himself as a coal miner from Varenne. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
Bram "Mud" Freaking and Wendel "Crow" Bangnbreach found a cat in the ruins at the Hanging Bridge and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Crow.
blight_802: Jakub "Owl" Blight came up with a draft of replacements on Day 10. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
Jakub "Owl" Blight got a letter from Clara. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.
butthole_tickling_bandit_: Viktor Bandit arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in R-R6 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-R6, Viktor Bandit listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Pavel Schwols and Viktor Bandit cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Viktor Bandit is number 888. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech.
dean.anthony.audio: Clement "Owl" Audio came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Clement "Owl" Audio watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Clement "Owl" Audio woke with his hair frozen to the sandbags. The cook brought tea so hot it hurt. Nobody complained.
doctor.gorilla: Tobias Gorilla arrived at R-R2 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Tobias Gorilla helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

A recruit asked Tobias Gorilla how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label. A letter from home reached Tobias Gorilla before dusk. Tobias Gorilla read it twice and slept a little easier.
dr8427932: Roland Dr introduced himself as a lamplighter from Ashford Vale. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Roland Dr looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Roland Dr as a story about a general. The ending was the same.
es31230: The new machine gunner is Edmund "Whistle" Es, once a shepherd from Coldwater. The corporal asked if a shepherd was any use in a trench. Edmund "Whistle" Es said he would find out.
The first hundred were recognised, and Edmund "Whistle" Es was among them. He wrote the news on the back of an unfinished letter.
Edmund "Whistle" Es wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
At the Weeping Orchard, Albin Chloe of the Hegemony and Edmund "Whistle" Es of the Concord fired at the same loose sheet of metal. The wind kept winning.
Verdel Ridge has been won. Edmund "Whistle" Es listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Edmund "Whistle" Es of the Concord and Emil Theramblingb of the Hegemony watched a broken branch near Hill 304 all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.
Edmund "Whistle" Es fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Zeno Smiridisnick, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything.

Edmund "Whistle" Es saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards. A letter from home found Edmund "Whistle" Es before the night shift. Edmund "Whistle" Es folded it small and kept it close. From Hill 304 the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Edmund "Whistle" Es wrote to the people he used to know that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Edmund "Whistle" Es lifted the trench periscope and found a spider across the mirror. For one startled second, the enemy seemed enormous.
Clement "Saint" Yokley held the mirror while Edmund "Whistle" Es shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.

Edmund "Whistle" Es had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Jakub Virajvirxgil was grazed. A letter from home found Edmund "Whistle" Es before the night shift. Edmund "Whistle" Es folded it small and kept it close.

Edmund "Whistle" Es swept the enemy parapet at R-F15 with one long burst. Dust jumped all along the sandbags. Otto "Ash" Jacob was badly wounded. A letter from home found Edmund "Whistle" Es before the night shift. Edmund "Whistle" Es folded it small and kept it close.

Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Edmund "Whistle" Es kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand. A letter from home found Edmund "Whistle" Es before the night shift. Edmund "Whistle" Es folded it small and kept it close.

Edmund "Whistle" Es was hit through the chest at R-F15. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Bram Wade of the Hegemony (@wade_b_p). Clean sheets, a lamp, and a surgeon. Edmund "Whistle" Es was admitted to the hospital dugout and finally let go of his rifle. Edmund "Whistle" Es is out of the worst of it. He sleeps most of the day, and the surgeon lets him.
gabhita09: The old hands of S-C10 have been here since Day 1. Ivo Gabhita has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Ivo Gabhita wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Ivo Gabhita sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway. The clerk counted the names twice. Ivo Gabhita is number 645 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand.
jhydra786: Felix "Parson" Jhydra arrived at U-F16 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
Felix "Parson" Jhydra counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool.
madhornet70: Viktor Madhornet arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in R-R10 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Viktor Madhornet during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better. The stretcher bearers took Viktor Madhornet in on a busy morning in R-R10. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

The men have learned that Viktor Madhornet sleeps with his boots on. Tonight it made them laugh, which was worth a great deal. A letter from home reached Viktor Madhornet before dusk. Viktor Madhornet read it twice and slept a little easier.
shri_mply: Felix Mply joined the replacements on Day 11. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
yijoon09: They issued Pavel Yijoon a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a key to a house that is no longer there in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.

The patrol came back one man at a time. Pavel Yijoon held the gap open and counted until the corporal said that was everyone. Mail came up the line with a letter for Pavel Yijoon. Pavel Yijoon read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Pavel Yijoon wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Dawn watch. Pavel Yijoon put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Arno Coopergfulto, badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Pavel Yijoon. Pavel Yijoon read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Pavel Yijoon worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.
Pavel Yijoon fired at the enemy dawn watch from R-F23. Gideon "Ghost" Marks was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
Pavel Yijoon fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Wendel Red was grazed, and that rifle did not fire again tonight.

The Concord raiders came over at R-F23 in the middle of the night. Pavel Yijoon met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Dorian Coloradoforw of the Concord (@coloradoforwardblake).
Emil Yijoon came to the front because his father Pavel Yijoon never came home. He carries a key to a house that is no longer there.

The old Private did not come back from the wire. Emil Yijoon wears his stripes now: Lance Corporal. Mail came up the line with a letter for Emil Yijoon. Emil Yijoon read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Emil Yijoon got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 323. The men who came later will ask about it.
youknowsomethings: The new stretcher bearer gave his name as Henrik Youknowsomet. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Henrik Youknowsomet read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Henrik Youknowsomet bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Henrik Youknowsomet is number 872. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech.
